theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V B Z : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (Ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Ψ B → InjOn Ψ B → (∀ w ∈ B, Bijective (fderiv ℝ Ψ w)) → (∀ w ∈ B, F (Ψ w) = w 0) → MeasurableSet Z → Z ⊆ V → Z ⊆ Ψ '' B → (∀ y ∈ Z, G (ψ y) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (G (ψ y)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Z ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Z ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in ψ '' Z, ‖G x‖ₑ * φ x ∂μHE[n + 1]
